parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main structural body of the microwave, made of stainless steel for durability and shielding.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, houses internal components, and acts as a Faraday cage to contain microwaves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door is a front panel made of tempered glass, allowing users to view food while cooking.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the cooking chamber, prevents microwave leakage, and provides access to the interior.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates on hinges to open and close, allowing access to the cooking area.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side controls are a plastic interface panel containing buttons or a touchpad for user input.
parts.Functional_description: They allow users to set cooking time, power level, and other functions.
parts.Movement_description: They are mostly static but include buttons or touch-sensitive areas that respond to user input.
